title: The demo kit stays the same all night
why: His answer Q67 (10-18): same kit all night, and a new kit after NEW PARTY. The two random guns are drawn once and kept in the party record; every drop and respawn uses them and NEW PARTY draws the next pair.
now: The starting guns stay the same all night and change after New party.
